intro: Celia Cumani Aintree (スィーリア・クマーニ・エイントリー Su~īria kumāni eintorī ?) Celia is the one protagonist of Mahou Kaiju Walkure Romanze. Celia is a third year at Winford school in the Knight department major and the student council president.
appearance: Celia is a beautiful young woman with thigh-length blonde hair that has tight curls at the bottom and the front with bangs hanging over the right side of her face, blue eyes. She wears the standard Winford uniform with a different color scheme (blue & gold) from the rest of students (red & black), composed of a white long-sleeve shirt and a blue skirt with white linings. Her outfit is also decorated with some medals and accolades from her jousting victories displayed on her chests, black pantyhose and a pair of long, black leather boots.
